ana: Heads-up — experimenting with a new priority-routing rule for Dedicated -> Hosted spillover; want quick feedback on isolation guarantees.
jamal: Quick q — does spillover keep tenant KV-cache separate? We can't share cached prefixes across hosted tenants.
sasha: Right, KV must be per-tenant. Current plan: when we spill to hosted, we spin up ephemeral model variant with tenant tag. Metric/telemetry implications?
megan: Telemetry ask: please emit `spillover_variant` and `isolation_level` tags. Prefer `isolation_level` values: `tenant`, `soft`, `region-failover`. Also include `spillover_latency_ms` histogram.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 10% spillover routing in us-west at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z.
ana: Proposed routing snippet (pseudo):
```
if capacity == 'dedicated' and queued > threshold:
  route -> hosted_variant(tenant_isolation=true, kv_namespace=tenant_id, x-tenant-lease=lease_token)
else if region_down:
  route -> hosted_region_fallback(tenant_isolation=false, fallback_variant=small_quantized)
```
jamal: Concern: hosted pool has different rate semantics. We need quota-preserving handshake, otherwise a tenant could be silently rate-limited by hosted pool spikes. Backpressure vs silent reroute?
sasha: Strong agree — require hosted to return explicit `X-Spillover-Accepted: true` and `x-remaining-quota` header, else reject with 429 to the caller.
megan: Console UX idea: add a 'Spillover' column in Routes view with toggle (allow spillover) + per-tenant opt-out. Also show live percent of requests spilled and link to sampled traces.
ana: Another open question: fallback strategy — lower-cost model variant (quantized) vs buffer queue. For short spikes buffer preferred, sustained overloads should use variant fallback. Need clear SLO guidance.
jamal: +1 on buffer first. We should expose `buffer_depth` and `buffer_latency_p50/95` in console and alert if buffer_age > config.
sasha: Instrumentation detail: emit `spillover_reason` values (cpu, gpu_mem, eviction, region_unreachable) and sample 1% of request payloads for debugging (PII redaction).
megan: I'll add a dashboard: heatmap by tenant x region showing spillover_rate, avg_latency, spillover_reason distribution. Alert if >0.5% spillover sustained for 30m.
ana: I'll draft a short RFC and include the snippet + telemetry proposal. Asking infra for ops/security review on per-tenant `kv_namespace` on hosted infra. cc @infra-bot
infra-bot: Security triage scheduled. Need details about KMS/HSM access pattern for tenant keys before approving per-tenant kv_namespace.
jamal: No objections to the pattern, but we should require `x-tenant-lease` signed token and ephemeral lease TTL <= 5m.
megan: Sounds good. I'll own the console work and the dashboard.
ops-bot: Reaction: :thumbsup:
ana: Thanks all. I'll file RFC, add the metrics list, and schedule a 30m sync if infra/security want to join.
